notes.title: Minor Bug Fix - v1.09
notes.notes: -Fixed a bug where ball abilities would get triggered immediately after choosing to restart a lane, causing a softlock in certain circumstances.

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes - v1.08
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added Skin selection per player. Press numbers 1-8 when on the skin select screen to assign the current skin to the relevant player.
[*]Fixed the extra throws after getting a strike/spare getting skipped on the final frame when playing multiplayer
[*]Fixed medal achievements not triggering for Super 100 pin and Mega 3 Pin modes
[*]Stopped window from resizing when loading into a new scene
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes - v1.07
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Made stars on 2-9 and 2-13 reachable
[*]The Stats screen now properly shows the number of stars collected
[*]Fixed skins that were unlocked but not showing up in the skin select menu
[*]Fixed 500/1000 Pin Achievements not triggering
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Patch - v1.06
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added dark mode to main options menu. This will change the loading transition screens from white to black.
[*]Fixed an issue with the in-game options menu that prevented it from being opened.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Bug Fix - v1.05
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Smoothed out the lane loading process to prevent getting stuck on a white screen and other issues related to restarting a lane.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Bug Fix - v1.04
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Small update to fix the Bowlour (Tutorial level) star not triggering unlocks correctly.
If you have previously collected the star and not received unlocks, go to the Unlocks>Data>Achievements menu and scroll through to retrigger.
[/list]
